text:
maya: Escalation from GreenLeaf — invoice #GL-2026-08 failed to process. Customer insists they were approved for Net 60 during sales call last Wed (Samir), but our payment flow shows card decline and no PO attached. They need service uninterrupted. Can we confirm whether we can provision a temporary credit or require PO before shipment?

samir (acct): I verbally committed to Net 60 to close the deal, but I did not get a signed amendment. Customer says they can get a PO today. Contact: operations@greenleaf.co, VAT ID: GB999888777.

josh: Logged payment attempt: payment_id pmt_8a9f, gateway response: "card_declined: insufficient_funds". Attached screenshot from customer. Also failure on webhook retries 3x.

billing-bot: Invoice GL-2026-08 | amount: 52,400 USD | status: PAYMENT_FAILED | decline_code: insufficient_funds | due_terms: net_60 (requested) | po_present: false

leah (finance): Per policy, Net terms > 30 days require signed PO + credit check for amounts > $25k. Verbal commitment isn't enough. If they supply a PO with authorized signature and VAT docs we can approve Net 60. Otherwise, prepayment required or one-time provisional credit with SRE hold.

maya: We need an expedited decision — customer threatens to pause production. Options: 1) grant provisional credit for current invoice pending PO and signed addendum, 2) require immediate prepay/charge card again, 3) suspend non-critical services. Which one is doable quickly?

kate (legal): We can draft a one-off addendum for Net 60 with personal guarantee? Prefer signed PO + standard T&C amendment. If finance approves provisional credit, legal needs copy of the signed addendum before release.

samir (acct): I'll get the PO and a scanned signature within 2 hours. Can finance do conditional hold if I upload the PO to this thread?

leah (finance): If you upload the PO and VAT registration, finance can provision a temporary credit hold of up to 60k while we complete credit checks. Please note: need PO number, signed name, company registration number, VAT cert.

josh: Repro notes for ops in case of routing side-effects: webhook payload shows 409 on retry due to missing PO metadata; payment re-attempt can be forced via admin panel: POST /admin/payments/retry {"payment_id":"pmt_8a9f"}. Use env: prod-us-east, do not trigger auto-retry flood.

maya: I'll collect PO & VAT cert and post here. Samir please confirm ETA. If finance approves provisional credit, can eng ops flip the service back to active once we see PO uploaded? :thinking:

samir (acct): ETA 1.5 hours. I'll DM the CFO to prioritize.

leah (finance): Affirmative — upload here and tag me, I'll approve provisional credit and notify ops. We'll require addendum within 7 days or revert.

kate (legal): I'll stand by to draft addendum. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks team — I'll update GreenLeaf and follow up in thread. :pray:

billing-bot: Note: temporary-credit-request created (id: tempc_2026_18425). Finance approver: leah. Workflow: pending_upload -> review -> approved/denied.

maya: Updated — customer uploaded PO GL-PO-9921 and VAT cert PDF. @leah tagging for review.

leah (finance): Received documents. Starting credit check now.

josh: When finance approves, ops note: to resume service and clear invoice status run: POST /admin/invoices/GL-2026-08/force_release — requires finance token.

leah (finance): Credit check passed. Provisional credit approved up to 60k. Approved for Net 60 for this invoice contingent on signed addendum within 7 days.

maya: Done — customer informed, services resumed. Closing escalation. :white_check_mark:
